title: Review: jmap-server (RFC 8620 dispatcher, parse, HTTP helpers)
notes: Idiom rating: CLEAN — no unsafe, no gratuitous clones, no unwrap outside tests. Two genuine idiom gaps: missing From<JmapError> for RequestError (P3), and Debug impl unnecessarily collects keys into Vec (P4). Everything else is idiomatic. Rust idiom confidence: 90% chance of no missed issues. Least confident: whether json_pointer_ext recursive clone at leaf could be eliminated with Cow or lifetime tricks — but the Option<Value> return type makes owned semantics unavoidable here.
